title: US-Led Maritime Security Center Raises Hormuz Threat Level to 'Severe'
detail: The US-led maritime security center has raised its threat level for the Middle East region to 'severe', signaling heightened risk for commercial and military shipping in and around the Strait of Hormuz. The elevated designation underscores continued exposure for tankers and bulk carriers transiting the strait amid ongoing regional tensions.

title: Middle East Oil Prices Approaching Pre-Iran War Levels, BBC Analysis Finds
detail: BBC analysis identifies three reasons Middle East oil prices are approaching pre-Iran war levels, suggesting some normalization in regional energy markets despite continued Hormuz tensions. This represents a potential softening in the supply shock that triggered the crisis, with implications for food transport costs and regional food security.
